violations.why: The task reads v_quiver[36] via v_summit in v_quartz. The ISR can then write v_quiver[36] through v_ember. The task then writes v_quiver[36] through v_ember, so the ISR's update is lost.
The task writes v_quiver[36] in the init loop. The ISR can overwrite it through v_pylon before the task reads it in v_summit, so the task reads the ISR's value.
